reading.label: Letters
reading.heading: Read the letters
reading.body: These are the exact letters and the first anchor word for this lesson. Read them aloud slowly before going further.
reading.note: The pictures below are only for memory support. The exact letters and words are the cards above.

cards.gloss: Longer sound with mango as the anchor word.

scenes.label: Lesson flow
scenes.heading: See the lesson in order
scenes.body: Each card shows one step of the lesson. Scroll from top to bottom to follow the order.

boards.label: Lesson 1
boards.title: Hindi Is For Me
boards.caption: Start with two sounds only, without pressure.
boards.aria: Lesson 1 cover card showing अ and आ with आम
boards.summaryText: The lesson opens by telling the learner that starting from zero is normal and safe.

boards.label: First Sound
boards.title: Meet the short sound
boards.caption: One letter, one sound, one calm step.
boards.aria: Scene 1 card showing अ
boards.summaryText: The learner sees one big letter and only one sound at a time, without overload.

boards.label: Long Sound
boards.title: Move to the longer sound
boards.caption: Read the letter, then connect it to the word below.
boards.aria: Scene 2 card showing आ and आम
boards.summaryTitle: Move to the longer sound आ
boards.summaryText: The second frame stretches the sound and keeps the teaching pace slow and clear.

boards.label: Compare
boards.title: Notice the difference
boards.caption: Short first, long second.
boards.aria: Scene 3 comparison card showing अ and आ
boards.summaryText: The learner now notices the difference between अ and आ instead of memorizing blindly.

boards.label: Anchor Word
boards.title: Attach the sound to the word
boards.caption: This is the exact word the learner should say with आ.
boards.aria: Scene 4 anchor card showing आम
boards.summaryText: The mango image turns the longer sound into a memorable real-world anchor.

boards.label: Trace
boards.title: Write after listening
boards.caption: Trace only after both sounds feel familiar.
boards.aria: Scene 5 tracing card showing अ and आ
boards.summaryText: The page ends the sequence by moving from listening into one small writing step.

reading.label: Letters
reading.heading: Read the letters
reading.body: These are the four letters and their anchor words for this lesson. Read each card aloud before moving on.
reading.note: The pictures below are only for memory support. The exact letters and words are the cards above.

scenes.label: Lesson flow
scenes.heading: See the lesson in order
scenes.body: Each card shows one step of the lesson. Scroll from top to bottom to follow the order.

boards.label: Lesson 2
boards.title: Swar Set 1
boards.caption: Exact reading card for the first four swar in this lesson.
boards.aria: Lesson 2 cover card showing the first four swar अ आ इ ई
boards.summaryTitle: Intro to the first four swar
boards.summaryText: The lesson starts by showing the child that only four sounds matter in this round: अ, आ, इ, and ई.

boards.label: Short and Long
boards.title: Begin with the first pair
boards.caption: Short sound first, then the longer open sound.
boards.aria: Scene 1 card showing अ and आ
boards.summaryText: The first pair establishes short-versus-long sound contrast using the simplest early vowels.

boards.label: Second Pair
boards.title: Add the front sounds
boards.caption: Read the letters first, then connect them to the words below.
boards.aria: Scene 2 card showing इ and ई with anchor words
boards.summaryText: The second pair extends the listening pattern without changing the basic teaching method.

boards.label: Anchor Words
boards.title: Match each sound to a word
boards.caption: These are the exact words learners should read and hear in this step.
boards.aria: Scene 3 card showing anchor words आम इमली ईख
boards.summaryText: The learner connects each sound to a familiar picture so recall becomes easier than raw memorization.

boards.label: Repeat Loop
boards.title: Say each sound seven times
boards.caption: Repeat in order, without rushing.
boards.aria: Scene 4 repetition card showing अ आ इ ई
boards.summaryText: The lesson stays on repetition long enough for the learner to hear the differences calmly.

boards.label: Quick Check
boards.title: Show the right sound card
boards.caption: Use this exact recap prompt before tracing begins.
boards.aria: Scene 5 recap card asking for आ इ and ई
boards.summaryText: The final frame turns listening confidence into tracing, only after the sounds already feel familiar.

reading.label: Letters
reading.heading: Read the letters
reading.body: These are the next four swar with their anchor words. Read each card aloud before moving on.
reading.note: The pictures below are only for memory support. The exact letters and words are the cards above.

scenes.label: Lesson flow
scenes.heading: See the lesson in order
scenes.body: Each card shows one step of the lesson. Scroll from top to bottom to follow the second swar set.

boards.label: Lesson 3
boards.title: Swar Set 2
boards.caption: Exact reading card for the second vowel set.
boards.aria: Lesson 3 cover card showing उ ऊ ए ऐ
boards.summaryText: The page opens by narrowing attention to four new sounds: उ, ऊ, ए, and ऐ.

boards.label: Rounded Pair
boards.title: Meet the rounded sounds
boards.caption: Read the short sound first, then the longer one.
boards.aria: Scene 1 card showing उ and ऊ
boards.summaryText: The learner first hears the short and long rounded pair side by side.

boards.label: Front Pair
boards.title: Add the front sounds
boards.caption: These two sounds should be heard and read separately.
boards.aria: Scene 2 card showing ए and ऐ
boards.summaryText: The teaching pattern repeats so the new pair feels familiar rather than difficult.

boards.label: Anchor Words
boards.title: Match each sound to a word
boards.caption: These are the exact words the learner should read and hear here.
boards.aria: Scene 3 card showing anchor words उल्लू ऊन एड़ी and ऐनक
boards.summaryTitle: Attach each sound to a word
boards.summaryText: Anchor words like उल्लू, ऊन, एड़ी, and ऐनक give each vowel a visual memory hook.

boards.label: Repeat Loop
boards.title: Say each sound slowly
boards.caption: Repeat calmly until the contrast feels easy.
boards.aria: Scene 4 repetition card showing उ ऊ ए ऐ
boards.summaryText: The learner stays with the sound pairs long enough to notice where confusion starts.

boards.label: Mixed Recap
boards.title: Mix the first eight swar
boards.hindi: अ  आ  इ  ई  उ  ऊ  ए  ऐ
boards.caption: This exact recap line leads into the confidence check.
boards.aria: Scene 5 mixed recap card showing eight swar
boards.summaryText: The final frame prepares the learner for the H1 confidence check by revisiting earlier swar together.

reading.label: Letters
reading.heading: Letter cards for the check
reading.body: Use these letter cards during the listening check. Point to the card that matches the sound you hear.
reading.note: The pictures below are only for memory support. The exact letters and words are the cards above.

scenes.label: Lesson flow
scenes.heading: See the check in order
scenes.body: Each card shows one step of the listening check. Scroll from top to bottom to follow the order.

boards.label: Lesson 4
boards.title: Listening Check
boards.hindi: अ  आ  इ  ई  उ  ऊ  ए  ऐ
boards.caption: Use exact text cards for the calm mixed-sound check.
boards.aria: Lesson 4 cover card showing the eight swar for the listening check
boards.summaryTitle: Set a calm tone for the check
boards.summaryText: The first frame makes it clear that this is a low-pressure check, not a stressful test.

boards.label: Round 1
boards.title: Hear the sound. Point to the card.
boards.hindi: अ  आ  इ  ई  उ  ऊ  ए  ऐ
boards.caption: All eight swar are visible for the first response round.
boards.aria: Scene 1 card showing all eight swar for hear and point round
boards.summaryText: The learner first responds only by recognizing the sound and pointing to the correct card.

boards.label: Round 2
boards.title: Hear the word. Choose the swar.
boards.hindi: आम   इमली   ईख   उल्लू   ऊन   एड़ी   ऐनक
boards.caption: These exact anchor words should drive the second round.
boards.aria: Scene 2 card showing anchor words for the word round
boards.summaryText: The learner now identifies the vowel from the anchor word instead of from the raw sound alone.

boards.label: Round 3
boards.title: Revise only the weak sounds
boards.caption: Keep the focus only on sounds that need help.
boards.aria: Scene 3 card showing only weak sounds are revised
boards.summaryText: The page focuses on missed sounds instead of repeating everything without purpose.

boards.label: Round 4
boards.title: Trace only the missed letters
boards.caption: Do not rewrite everything. Keep the check light.
boards.aria: Scene 4 tracing card showing missed letters only
boards.summaryText: The learner writes only the sounds that still need support, keeping the task calm and focused.

boards.label: Decision
boards.title: Repeat here or move to the next section
boards.caption: This is the preview of what comes next if the learner is ready.
boards.aria: Scene 5 move-on card pointing to the next consonant section
boards.summaryText: The last frame closes H1 by asking one practical question: repeat calmly or move ahead with confidence.
